title: MOST SUBSCRIBED
subtitle: YOUTUBE - 2013 to 2026
outro:
Follow for the numbers
nobody explains.
vo: For years, PewDiePie was the undisputed king of YouTube, the first to dominate the platform. Then a music channel from India, T-Series, began an unstoppable climb, sparking the biggest subscriber war in history. And just when it seemed settled, one creator rewrote the rules entirely. MrBeast. By twenty twenty-six, the throne belongs to a whole new kind of star. Who takes it next? Follow, for the numbers nobody explains.
